fact: The Presidency says the KOICA-funded, UNDP- and SMEDAN-run US$12m Abuja Centre for Entrepreneurship, with incubation and enterprise support for start-ups, is under construction at the SMEDAN Industrial Development Centre in Idu, Abuja.
SMEDAN, with KOICA funding of $12 million and UNDP, broke ground on the Abuja Centre for Entrepreneurship, to host incubation space and support 500 young entrepreneurs and 400 start-ups.

KOICA and SMEDAN began the ACE Startup Academy 2026 Founder Training in Abuja on 24 August 2026 for about 120 participants in some 50 teams chosen from 3,856 applicants, leading to a roughly six-month business incubation for ten teams.

The NCC signed a 15-year lease of its Digital Industrial Park in Enugu to the state government, which will run it as Enugu Talent City; the NCC says the buildings were completed but are still to be activated.

Voice of Nigeria reports First Lady Oluremi Tinubu laid the foundation stone for the Renewed Hope Startup Hub in Wuye, Abuja, built with a JICA grant of US$10.4 million and run by NITDA once complete.
